name: Jephunneh (Caleb's father)
title: The Kenite who became part of Judah
summary: Jephunneh was the father of Caleb, one of the two spies who gave a positive report about the land of Canaan. He is described as a Kenite, indicating that he came from a non-Israelite tribe that was incorporated into the tribe of Judah. Through his son Caleb, Jephunneh became the ancestor of an important family in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Identified as a Kenite
keyEvents.description: Jephunneh is described as a Kenite, a tribe that was allied with Israel and later integrated into the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Father of the spy Caleb
keyEvents.description: Jephunneh was the father of Caleb, who along with Joshua were the only spies who encouraged the people to take possession of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's inheritance is mentioned in reference to Jephunneh
keyEvents.description: When Caleb asked for Hebron as his inheritance, he was identified as 'Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenite'.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage Preserved
keyEvents.description: Jephunneh's name is mentioned repeatedly in connection with Caleb's faithfulness and his inheritance in the promised land.
